name: message_id
label: Message ID
help: SentFromAI message UUID, not the email Message-ID header.

name: client_id
label: Idempotency key
help: Optional, 1-255 UTF-8 bytes. Use a stable unique key for this logical reply. Retry only with the same key and identical content. If the result is uncertain or 409, investigate; do not switch to a new key.
